description: This file is the main entry point for the Swabble command-line interface (CLI), defining the CLI's command dispatch logic using async functions. It imports the Commander library for command parsing and Foundation for core utilities. It contains the main runCLI function and various handlers for subcommands, including 'swabble', 'mic', 'service', and others, along with their associated actions.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Main async function to execute the CLI, resolving arguments, dispatching commands, and handling errors.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the main command based on the first argument, calling subcommand handlers.

methods.name: dispatchSwabble
methods.description: Handles the 'swabble' command, dispatching to specific subcommands.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping subcommand names to their async handler functions.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Extracts a subcommand from the provided path at a specified index, throwing an error if missing.
